extension.summary: Una skin minimalista de diseño horizontal
extension.description: Arctic Fuse 3 is a minimal row based skin with customisable widgets
Arctic Fuse 3 es una skin minimalista de diseño horizontal con widgets personalizables
Arctic Fuse 3 ist ein minimalistisches, zeilenbasiertes Skin mit anpassbaren Widgets
Arctic Fuse 3 是一款采用简约行式布局的 Kodi 皮肤，支持小组件自定义功能
Arctic Fuse 3 سكن مخفف بقوائم افقية وبامكانية تخصيص الاختصارات
extension.news:
v3.2.53 - Keep TMDb Helper Watchlist detail dialogs open and switch Add/Remove state immediately while PKC verifies Plex in the background. - Use PKC's native per-item Plex Watchlist state for the button label and icon instead of relying on the current listing. - Replace the detail action glyphs with focused PNG states for Play, Add to Watchlist, and Remove from Watchlist. - Include the latest Icon Selector sorting and category improvements.
v3.2.51 - Package the default Skin Variables generated-include fallback so Arctic Fuse 3 can always load after an update or restart. - Package the empty skin timer definition required by Kodi during Arctic Fuse startup.
v3.2.50 - Run the TMDb Helper Watchlist command before closing its detail dialog, preserving the exact TMDb ID for PKC.
v3.2.49 - Send TMDb Helper Watchlist actions to PKC with the exact TMDb ID instead of title and year. - Add a Plex Discovery shortcut backed by PKC's native Plex Discover browser.
v3.2.21 - Restore the original Wall Poster info header when the details variant is also available.
v3.2.20 - Split the poster wall details design into a separate Wall Poster - Details view variant.
v3.2.19 - Add a poster wall details layout with visible titles, alphabet rail navigation, and corner-safe watched indicators.
v3.2.18 - Hide the fullscreen busy spinner once video playback has media and is no longer caching.
v3.2.17 - Add tenth-percent PKC skip marker fill frames for smoother countdown motion.
v3.2.16 - Render the PKC skip marker countdown as a 12px-radius background fill instead of a separate progress line.
v3.2.15 - Move the PKC skip marker OSD pill to the lower-right viewing area and use a smooth progress countdown.
v3.2.14 - Add a PKC marker-aware OSD skip action for intro, credit, and commercial markers.
v3.2.13 - Add a post-update skin reload recovery service so active Arctic updates return Kodi to Home instead of leaving the UI black or stranded on a destroyed window.
v3.2.12 - Prevent live skin-update reloads from rerunning the startup splash and hub preloading flow, which could leave Kodi without a usable UI.
v3.2.11 - Fix Spotify music OSD next-track overlay focus so hovering the next button keeps a real skip-next control active.
v3.2.10 - Primez branch metadata/version bump for repository auto-updates.
